newsitem.title: USA: CapStar says hotel acquisitions accretive.
newsitem.headline: CapStar says hotel acquisitions accretive.

text.p: CapStar Hotel Corp said Wednesday it had signed agreements to purchase eight hotels for $118.75 million, a deal it expects will be accretive to its 1997 net income after taking into account a proposed common stock offering.

The hotels are to be acquired in three separate transactions for $89.25 million in cash and $29.5 million in operating partnership units. The partnership units are to be convertible into shares of common stock.
The transactions are expected to close within 60 days, CapStar said.
Six of the hotels, which were acquired from affiliates of Highgate Hotels Inc, are in Vancouver, British Columbia; Calgary, Alberta; Dallas, and Indianapolis.

CapStar said the two companies also have agreed to work together on future hotel acquisitions. It also plans to nominate one Highgate executive to a new seat on CapStar's board of directors, increasing the panel's size to 10.
It also purchased a Philadelphia hotel from Glen Lincoln Inc, and a hotel in Cherry Hill, N.J., from SP Associates.
